test_GoToTarget_observables: test that the GoToTarget task exposes the walker/target observable in the environment timestep
test_GoToTarget_target_position_randomiz: test that GoToTarget randomizes the target position each time the environment is reset
test_GoToTarget_reward_fixed_target: test that a fixed target GoToTask gives reward 1 when the walker reaches the target
test_GoToTarget_reward_moving_target: test that a moving target GoToTask moves the target after steps_before_moving_target steps
test_GoToTarget_termination_and_discount: test that GoToTarget triggers failure termination and zero discount when the walker falls over
